notes.title: Meth Gator Update! (+ More)
notes.content:
(Old Saves may be broken do to the update) 

Enjoy the New Update!

[h1][b]To relive Kevin's Nam' Memories:[/b][/h1]

Beat the game and get to the end Island. (We suggest you save once you get there) from there you should see a bed... get in it to sleep. You may experience flashbacks in your dreams, however.

notes.title: Bug Fixing Underway!
notes.content:
We are aware of the 'death by killcount' glitch in the final level and are working to release the update for it as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience!
